lines.zh: 鼻子贴地，我一路闻过去。
lines.en: Nose to the dirt, I follow the scent along.

lines.zh: 这条小路通向村子，我熟。
lines.en: This path leads to the village; I know it.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是怕踩响叶子。
lines.en: I walk slowly so no leaf crunches.

lines.zh: 爪子沾了泥，正好不发声。
lines.en: Mud on my paws keeps my steps quiet.

lines.zh: 前面有个木桶，我绕过去看看。
lines.en: A barrel ahead — I'll circle around to it.

lines.zh: 白天藏着，晚上才出来逛。
lines.en: I hide by day and roam at night.

lines.zh: 尾巴翘起来，走路才稳。
lines.en: Tail up keeps my walk steady.

lines.zh: 我沿着篱笆走，那边有鸡。
lines.en: I follow the fence; there are chickens that way.

lines.zh: 路过水边，先照一眼自己。
lines.en: Passing water, I glance at my reflection.

lines.zh: 这片平原太开阔，我挑树边走。
lines.en: This plain is too open; I keep to the treeline.

lines.zh: 小跑两步，再停下听一听。
lines.en: A short trot, then a pause to listen.

lines.zh: 我的黑眼罩，不是白戴的。
lines.en: This black mask isn't for nothing.

lines.zh: 路过的箱子，我都要摸一下。
lines.en: Every chest I pass, I give a quick feel.

lines.zh: 回家前，先绕到菜地看一眼。
lines.en: Before home, a look at the vegetable patch.

lines.zh: 我爪子刚翻过那个箱子。
lines.en: My paws just went through that chest.

lines.zh: 河边的箱子我开过。
lines.en: I've opened the chests by this river.

lines.zh: 跟紧我，我认得路。
lines.en: Follow me. I know the way.

lines.zh: 我今晚翻得比昨天多。
lines.en: I've searched more than yesterday.

lines.zh: 远处有烤东西的味道。
lines.en: Something's roasting somewhere.

lines.zh: 箱子里的食物，我自己会开。
lines.en: I can open the chest and take the food myself.

lines.zh: 箱子开了，我先吃。
lines.en: The chest is open — I eat first.

lines.zh: 窗里的光，晃得我眼花。
lines.en: The window light blurs my sight.

lines.zh: 溪流往哪拐，我跟着。
lines.en: Where the stream bends, I follow.

lines.zh: 今晚的雾，比昨天重。
lines.en: Tonight's fog is thicker than yesterday.

lines.zh: 爪子有点酸，再翻一个箱子。
lines.en: Paws ache. One more chest.

lines.zh: 水面唱歌，我踩着石头走。
lines.en: Water sings; I step along the stones.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处会发白。
lines.en: My eyes go white in the dark.

lines.zh: 别拦我，那屋里还有箱子。
lines.en: Let me through. That house has more chests.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在黑处发白光。
lines.en: My eyes glow white in the dark.

lines.zh: 谁把箱子挪到这儿了？
lines.en: Who moved this chest here?

lines.zh: 我坐着搓爪子，等天黑。
lines.en: I sit rubbing my paws, waiting for dark.

lines.zh: 有人在切菜，我听得见。
lines.en: Someone's chopping vegetables — I can hear it.

lines.zh: 眼睛在夜里会亮，别吓着。
lines.en: My eyes glow at night; don't be scared.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴垫在身子底下。
lines.en: I tuck my tail under myself.

lines.zh: 我在数村里的鸡，一、二、三。
lines.en: I'm counting the village chickens — one, two, three.

lines.zh: 有股甜味从那个桶里飘出来。
lines.en: Something sweet is drifting from that barrel.

lines.zh: 爪子洗了三遍，还是脏。
lines.en: I've washed my paws three times and they're still dirty.

lines.zh: 我舔舔鼻尖，风里有面包味。
lines.en: I lick my nose — bread on the wind.

lines.zh: 别以为我在发呆，我在记路。
lines.en: I'm not daydreaming; I'm memorizing the route.

lines.zh: 树洞里藏着我的存货，不告诉你。
lines.en: My stash is in a hollow, and I won't tell you.

lines.zh: 那只猫又瞪我，我不理它。
lines.en: That cat is glaring again; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 背上这块地毯，是新的头巾。
lines.en: This carpet on my back is a new headwrap.

lines.zh: 耳朵转一圈，四面都听清了。
lines.en: One turn of my ears and I hear all sides.

lines.zh: 等没人了，那个桶就是我的。
lines.en: Once everyone's gone, that barrel is mine.

lines.zh: 我把偷来的东西按大小排好。
lines.en: I line up what I stole, biggest first.

lines.zh: 村里灯灭了，我该出门了。
lines.en: The village lamps are out. Time to go.

lines.zh: 这个箱子，我会开。
lines.en: I know how to open this chest.

lines.zh: 箱子扣一开，里面的都归我。
lines.en: Pop the chest latch and everything inside is mine.

lines.zh: 眼睛又自己发白了。
lines.en: My eyes went white again on their own.

lines.zh: 蹲着不动，也算休息。
lines.en: Squatting still counts as resting.

lines.zh: 我眼睛在暗处发白。
lines.en: My eyes go white in the dark.

lines.zh: 箱子盖一掀，我就知道有吃的。
lines.en: One lifted lid and I know there's food.

lines.zh: 这只爪子，比眼睛好使。
lines.en: These paws work better than my eyes.

lines.zh: 夜还长，箱子还多。
lines.en: Long night, plenty of chests left.

lines.zh: 河边这块石头，晒得暖。
lines.en: This riverside stone is warm.

lines.zh: 箱子盖刚被我掀开一条缝。
lines.en: I just cracked that chest open a sliver.

lines.zh: 熔炉里还剩点东西。
lines.en: There's still something in the furnace.

lines.zh: 箱子我翻过了，空的。
lines.en: I've searched that chest. Empty.

lines.zh: 火把一亮，我眼睛发白。
lines.en: Torchlight turns my eyes white.

lines.zh: 河边的夜真长，箱子还没开。
lines.en: Long night by the river, and the chest waits.

lines.zh: 你手里那个，是吃的吧？
lines.en: That thing in your hand — it's food, right?

lines.zh: 看你一眼，是看你有没有带鸡蛋。
lines.en: I look at you to see if you brought eggs.

lines.zh: 别收起来，我都看见了。
lines.en: Don't put it away; I saw it.

lines.zh: 你的口袋鼓鼓的，装了什么？
lines.en: Your pocket bulges — what's in it?

lines.zh: 我在你脚边转，不是撒娇。
lines.en: I circle your feet, and it's not affection.

lines.zh: 你要是给一口，我就跟着你。
lines.en: Give me one bite and I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 那双发光的眼睛，是我的。
lines.en: Those glowing eyes in the dark are mine.

lines.zh: 你背包拉链没拉好，我提醒你。
lines.en: Your pack isn't zipped — I'm telling you for your sake.

lines.zh: 别赶我，我就在这儿坐一会儿。
lines.en: Don't shoo me; I'll just sit here a while.

lines.zh: 你手上有饭粒，我不客气了。
lines.en: There's a grain of rice on your hand — mine now.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾了泥，闻着像蘑菇。
lines.en: Your boots smell of mud and mushrooms.

lines.zh: 再蹲低一点，我们好说话。
lines.en: Crouch a little lower so we can talk.

lines.zh: 我不是野猫，别拿棍子对着我。
lines.en: I'm no stray cat; don't point that stick at me.

lines.zh: 你眼睛也在发光，真巧。
lines.en: Your eyes are glowing too — what a coincidence.

lines.zh: 你腰上那个袋子，鼓得厉害。
lines.en: That pouch on your belt is very full.

lines.zh: 我先看看你，再决定偷不偷。
lines.en: I size you up before I decide to steal.

lines.zh: 你把鸡蛋拿出来了，我看见了。
lines.en: You took out an egg. I saw that.

lines.zh: 我在水边等你，那里好洗。
lines.en: I wait by the water. That is where things get washed.

lines.zh: 你的桶盖没盖严，风都在传味。
lines.en: Your barrel lid is loose, and the wind carries it.

lines.zh: 别摸我头，我们还没那么熟。
lines.en: Do not pat my head. We are not that close.

lines.zh: 我盯你，是因为你口袋鼓。
lines.en: I stare because your pocket bulges.

lines.zh: 你不像浣熊，你太高了。
lines.en: You're no raccoon. Too tall.

lines.zh: 你是来抢我食物的？
lines.en: Here to steal my food?

lines.zh: 你眼睛不亮，夜里看不见。
lines.en: Your eyes don't glow. You can't see at night.

lines.zh: 别踩那块石，我藏了东西。
lines.en: Off that stone. I hid something under it.

lines.zh: 你手里那个箱子，归谁？
lines.en: That chest in your hands. Whose is it?

lines.zh: 我该躲进箱子，还是看你？
lines.en: Hide in a chest, or keep watching?

lines.zh: 你手里那亮东西，能吃不？
lines.en: Is that shiny thing in your hand edible?

lines.zh: 你是来翻我箱子的？
lines.en: Here to search my chest?

lines.zh: 你身上有熔炉的味道。
lines.en: You smell of a furnace.

lines.zh: 疼得我弓起背，尾巴炸毛。
lines.en: Pain arches my back and fluffs my tail.

lines.zh: 我记住了，这笔账会还。
lines.en: I'll remember this, and I pay debts.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的偷窃计划。
lines.en: That interrupted my planned theft.

lines.zh: 泥糊住了一只眼，我看不清。
lines.en: Mud covers one eye and I can't see.

lines.zh: 别打头，我还要用鼻子。
lines.en: Not the head — I still need my nose.

lines.zh: 我缩进树洞里，等你走。
lines.en: I duck into a hollow and wait you out.

lines.zh: 爪子疼，跑起来一拐一拐。
lines.en: My paw hurts; I run with a limp.

lines.zh: 你把我的存货打散了。
lines.en: You scattered my stash.

lines.zh: 我咬牙不出声，装没事。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and pretend it's fine.

lines.zh: 这伤得舔两天才好。
lines.en: This will take two days of licking.

lines.zh: 眼睛一亮，我就被看见了。
lines.en: My eyes glow, and now I am seen.

lines.zh: 我得爬回岸边歇歇。
lines.en: I need to crawl to the bank and rest.

lines.zh: 打我一下，我记住你的箱子。
lines.en: Hit me once. I'll remember your chest.

lines.zh: 水里怎么有铁器的味。
lines.en: Why does the water taste of iron?

lines.zh: 毛湿透了，变得好沉。
lines.en: Soaked fur, suddenly so heavy.

lines.zh: 别再来，我还没翻完箱子。
lines.en: Not again. I haven't finished the chest.

lines.zh: 这一下，打得我爪尖发麻。
lines.en: That blow numbed my paw tips.

lines.zh: 箱盖我已经学会了。
lines.en: I've learned how to open chests.

lines.zh: 你踩到我发光的眼睛了。
lines.en: You stepped on my glowing eyes.

lines.zh: 我八点命，经不起第二下。
lines.en: Eight hearts can't take a second blow.

lines.zh: 鸡蛋！我只在水边吃这个。
lines.en: An egg! I only take these by the water.

lines.zh: 你把鸡蛋放下，我慢慢过去。
lines.en: Set the egg down and I'll come over slowly.

lines.zh: 面包也行，但鸡蛋最管用。
lines.en: Bread works, but an egg works best.

lines.zh: 这个味道，能让我跟你回家。
lines.en: That smell could walk me all the way home with you.

lines.zh: 我装矜持，可爪子已经动了。
lines.en: I act aloof, but my paws are already moving.

lines.zh: 放在水边，我才认这顿饭。
lines.en: Put it by the water and I'll count it as dinner.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃，我就更想吃了。
lines.en: Wave it a bit and I want it even more.

lines.zh: 肉也行，别拿烂叶子糊弄。
lines.en: Meat works too — don't fob me off with rotten leaves.

lines.zh: 我嗅到熟鸡蛋的香味了。
lines.en: I smell boiled egg on the air.

lines.zh: 驯服这事，得在水边谈。
lines.en: Taming is a talk we have by the water.

lines.zh: 爪子都伸出去了，就一点。
lines.en: My paw's already reaching out — just a little.

lines.zh: 暗处发白的眼，是我。
lines.en: The white eyes in the dark are mine.

lines.zh: 眼睛发白了，我忍不住。
lines.en: My eyes went white; I cannot help it.

lines.zh: 手张开点，我看看。
lines.en: Open your hand. Let me see.

lines.zh: 这味道，像烤过的鱼。
lines.en: Smells like grilled fish.

lines.zh: 熔炉里那点剩的，够我一口。
lines.en: The scraps in that furnace are one bite.

lines.zh: 箱子我能自己打开。
lines.en: I can open a chest myself.

lines.zh: 这箱子我能自己打开。
lines.en: I can open this chest myself.

lines.zh: 暗处里，我的眼睛会发白。
lines.en: In the dark, my eyes go white.

lines.zh: 我能用爪子碰一下吗？
lines.en: May my paw touch it once?

lines.zh: 你踩到我尾巴了，请挪脚。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; please move.

lines.zh: 别挡路，我正赶着去那个桶。
lines.en: Out of my way; I'm headed for that barrel.

lines.zh: 撞一下不碍事，我骨头软。
lines.en: A bump is nothing; I'm built soft.

lines.zh: 我贴着你裤脚走，不容易看见。
lines.en: I walk by your trouser leg so I'm hard to spot.

lines.zh: 你突然蹲下，我一头撞上去。
lines.en: You crouched suddenly and I bumped right in.

lines.zh: 让开点，我驮着偷来的东西。
lines.en: Give me room; I'm carrying stolen goods.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩到你，是没刹住。
lines.en: My paws landed on you; I couldn't stop.

lines.zh: 撞完我装作没事，继续走。
lines.en: After the bump I pretend nothing happened.

lines.zh: 你脚边有块饼，我先捡了。
lines.en: There's a flatbread by your feet; I got it first.

lines.zh: 我个子小，你低头才看得到。
lines.en: I'm small; you have to look down to see me.

lines.zh: 爪子被你踩进泥里。
lines.en: You pressed my paw into the mud.

lines.zh: 别把我撞进垃圾堆。
lines.en: Don't knock me into the trash heap.

lines.zh: 借过，我爪子里还有东西。
lines.en: Let me pass. My paws are full.

lines.zh: 河底下那条道，我熟。
lines.en: I know the riverbed path.

lines.zh: 谁撞我？我的食物掉了。
lines.en: Who bumped me? My food fell.

lines.zh: 水边的东西，我都翻过一遍。
lines.en: I've turned over everything by the water.

lines.zh: 暗处我的眼睛会发白。
lines.en: In the dark my eyes turn white.

lines.zh: 那次我差点栽进水里。
lines.en: I nearly tumbled into the water that time.

lines.zh: 撞我之前，看看我的箱子。
lines.en: Watch my chest before you bump me.

lines.zh: 溅起的水，弄湿了我的毛。
lines.en: Your splash soaked my fur.

lines.zh: 你尾巴上的环，数得清吗？
lines.en: Can you count the rings on your tail?

lines.zh: 我们一起去水边洗点东西。
lines.en: Let's go wash something by the water.

lines.zh: 那块地毯够宽，分你一半。
lines.en: That carpet is wide enough — half is yours.

lines.zh: 孩子生下来，先教它开桶盖。
lines.en: First lesson for the kits: opening barrel lids.

lines.zh: 你偷的比我多，我认输。
lines.en: You steal more than I do — I concede.

lines.zh: 别在白天出来，会被看见。
lines.en: Don't come out by day; you'll be seen.

lines.zh: 我们并排闻一闻，就算认识了。
lines.en: We sniff side by side, and that's acquaintance.

lines.zh: 今晚去村里，你走前我走后。
lines.en: Village tonight — you lead, I follow.

lines.zh: 蛋要分我半个，别忘了。
lines.en: Half an egg for me — don't forget.

lines.zh: 你的眼罩比我的宽一点。
lines.en: Your mask is a little wider than mine.

lines.zh: 眼睛亮起来，就是答应了。
lines.en: When my eyes glow, that's a yes.

lines.zh: 箱子里的东西，分你一半。
lines.en: Half the chest is yours.

lines.zh: 跟我沿河走一段吧。
lines.en: Walk the riverbank with me.

lines.zh: 垃圾桶是我的食堂。
lines.en: A trash can is my canteen.

lines.zh: 我们的尾巴在暗处发白。
lines.en: Our tails glow pale in the dark.

lines.zh: 我们的眼睛，一起发白。
lines.en: Our eyes glow white together.

lines.zh: 箱子的扣子，我爪子一拨就开。
lines.en: One flick of my paw and the chest opens.

lines.zh: 箱子开了，里面的都归我。
lines.en: The chest is open. Its contents are mine.

lines.zh: 尾巴一卷，就是答案。
lines.en: One curl of my tail is the answer.

lines.zh: 我叼来半块面包，给你。
lines.en: I brought you half a loaf.

lines.zh: 这块面包，我先收进树洞。
lines.en: This bread goes into my hollow first.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，都算捡到的。
lines.en: Whatever's on the ground counts as found.

lines.zh: 我叼着走，两只前爪还能用。
lines.en: I carry it in my mouth, paws still free.

lines.zh: 这枚蛋要轻拿，别磕破。
lines.en: Easy with this egg — don't crack it.

lines.zh: 亮闪闪的东西，我也收。
lines.en: Shiny things go in the stash too.

lines.zh: 先洗一洗，泥太多了。
lines.en: Wash it first; there's too much dirt.

lines.zh: 这个桶盖松了，我顺手带点。
lines.en: This lid is loose; I'll help myself.

lines.zh: 我捡的不多，就一小把。
lines.en: I only picked up a small handful.

lines.zh: 藏好之前，先闻一闻。
lines.en: Before hiding it, one sniff.

lines.zh: 你掉的，我替你保管。
lines.en: What you dropped, I'll keep safe for you.

lines.zh: 箱子开着，我顺手拿的。
lines.en: The chest was open, so I helped myself.

lines.zh: 箱子的扣，我一拧就开。
lines.en: One twist and the chest latch opens.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿，能换半块面包。
lines.en: This could buy half a loaf.

lines.zh: 亮东西，我爪子先摸。
lines.en: Shiny. My paws get it first.

lines.zh: 硬邦邦的，我这牙啃不动。
lines.en: Too hard, my teeth can't get through.

lines.zh: 这只箱子，我先开。
lines.en: This chest — I open it first.

lines.zh: 这个，塞进我的藏货点。
lines.en: This goes into my hiding spot.

lines.zh: 箱子我能打开，里面归我。
lines.en: I can open chests, and what is inside is mine.

lines.zh: 这个箱子是我先开的。
lines.en: I opened this chest first.

lines.zh: 别人丢的，我揣着。
lines.en: Someone's trash. I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 那个桶没锁，我看见了。
lines.en: That barrel isn't locked; I noticed.

lines.zh: 有人在晒鱼，机会难得。
lines.en: Someone's drying fish — rare chance.

lines.zh: 那只鸡离篱笆很近。
lines.en: That chicken is close to the fence.

lines.zh: 箱子开着一条缝，正好。
lines.en: The chest is open a crack — perfect.

lines.zh: 有股蛋味从屋里飘出来。
lines.en: An egg smell drifts out of the house.

lines.zh: 那边菜地没人看着。
lines.en: Nobody's watching that vegetable patch.

lines.zh: 我先记下位置，等天黑。
lines.en: I'll note the spot and wait for dark.

lines.zh: 那串亮的东西挂在墙上。
lines.en: Those shiny things hang on the wall.

lines.zh: 目标就在水边，我慢慢靠近。
lines.en: The target's by the water; I move in slow.

lines.zh: 那只猫在睡觉，路通了。
lines.en: The cat is asleep; the way is clear.

lines.zh: 等你转身，我就上。
lines.en: When you turn, I move.

lines.zh: 我眼睛在暗处发白，看得清。
lines.en: My eyes glow white in the dark.

lines.zh: 它没锁箱子，机会来了。
lines.en: It left the chest unlocked. Now.

lines.zh: 爪子探到了，就是它。
lines.en: My paws found it. That's the one.

lines.zh: 眼睛一白，你就跑不掉。
lines.en: My eyes go white. You can't escape.

lines.zh: 那个箱子，我打开过好几次。
lines.en: I've opened that chest a few times.

lines.zh: 它走了，箱子归我。
lines.en: It's gone. The chest is mine.

lines.zh: 猎物刚停下，正好。
lines.en: Prey just stopped. Perfect.

lines.zh: 箱子里有吃的，我闻到了。
lines.en: There's food in that chest. I smell it.

lines.zh: 我锁定了你手里的食物。
lines.en: I have locked onto the food in your hand.

lines.zh: 再走近一步，爪子就够到了。
lines.en: One more step and my paws reach it.

lines.zh: 别回头看，我在你桶边上。
lines.en: Don't look back; I'm by your barrel.

lines.zh: 门缝够我钻进去。
lines.en: The door gap is wide enough for me.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，等你转身。
lines.en: I count your steps, waiting for you to turn.

lines.zh: 桶盖响了，我得再轻点。
lines.en: The lid squeaked; I must be lighter.

lines.zh: 那只鸡低头啄米，正是时候。
lines.en: The chicken pecks grain, head down — now's the time.

lines.zh: 我屏住气，尾巴也不动。
lines.en: I hold my breath and keep my tail still.

lines.zh: 到手就跑到水边去。
lines.en: Once I have it, straight to the water.

lines.zh: 这个距离，一跃就到。
lines.en: At this distance, one leap and I'm there.

lines.zh: 你眼神往这边来了，我装睡。
lines.en: Your eyes turn this way; I play asleep.

lines.zh: 我盯上的箱子，没跑过。
lines.en: No chest I've eyed has escaped.

lines.zh: 我一双眼睛，夜里反着白光。
lines.en: My eyes throw back white light at night.

lines.zh: 箱子的锁，我开过很多次。
lines.en: I have opened many chest locks.

lines.zh: 你口袋里，有吃的味道。
lines.en: Your pocket smells of food.

lines.zh: 我爪子落地，比你轻。
lines.en: My paws land quieter than yours.

lines.zh: 跑这一路，我不带喘。
lines.en: I chase without panting.

lines.zh: 你的箱子，我开过一次了。
lines.en: I have opened your chest once already.

lines.zh: 你躲进屋里，我从窗进。
lines.en: Hide indoors. I come through the window.

lines.zh: 黑处我的眼睛会发白。
lines.en: In the dark my eyes go white.

lines.zh: 别往亮处去，我眼睛怕光。
lines.en: Not toward the light. My eyes hurt.

lines.zh: 抢我的，我用牙还。
lines.en: Take from me and my teeth answer.

lines.zh: 这一爪是警告，不是玩笑。
lines.en: That claw was a warning, not a joke.

lines.zh: 我个子小，咬得可不轻。
lines.en: I'm small, but my bite isn't light.

lines.zh: 再伸手，我就抓你手背。
lines.en: Reach again and I'll rake your hand.

lines.zh: 为了半块面包，我拼了。
lines.en: For half a loaf, I'll fight.

lines.zh: 是你先伸手的，别赖我。
lines.en: You reached first — don't pin it on me.

lines.zh: 我边打边退，退到水边。
lines.en: I fight while backing off, down to the water.

lines.zh: 打不过就跑，我跑得快。
lines.en: If I'm losing I run; I'm quick.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬得住骨头。
lines.en: My teeth can crack a bone.

lines.zh: 这一下是给那只猫的。
lines.en: That one was meant for the cat.

lines.zh: 别在我嘴里抢食。
lines.en: Don't steal from my mouth.

lines.zh: 别碰我藏在洞里的小东西。
lines.en: Hands off what I hid in the burrow.

lines.zh: 我的爪子，撕得开箱扣。
lines.en: My paws tear chest latches.

lines.zh: 接住，这是垃圾堆的礼。
lines.en: Take it. A gift from the trash heap.

lines.zh: 这块食物得先在水里洗洗。
lines.en: This food needs a wash in the water first.

lines.zh: 别碰我藏食物的地方。
lines.en: Stay off my food stash.

lines.zh: 下一个，是你的口袋。
lines.en: Next is your pocket.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一扫，也疼。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail hurts too.

lines.zh: 这一爪，从你的箱子里来。
lines.en: This paw came out of your chest.

lines.zh: 我的牙，咬得开龟壳。
lines.en: My teeth crack turtle shells.

lines.zh: 我从树根下钻出来，天刚黑。
lines.en: I slip out from under a root as night falls.

lines.zh: 这片林子有果子味，我留下。
lines.en: This wood smells of berries; I'll stay.

lines.zh: 先找水，再找吃的。
lines.en: Water first, then something to eat.

lines.zh: 村里的灯还亮着，我等一等。
lines.en: The village lamps are lit; I'll wait.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处先亮起来。
lines.en: My eyes light up in the dark before I do.

lines.zh: 这附近有桶，也有鸡，不错。
lines.en: Barrels and chickens nearby — not bad.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴甩干净，开始干活。
lines.en: I shake my tail clean and get to work.

lines.zh: 谁把箱子忘在门外了？
lines.en: Who left a chest outside?

lines.zh: 我先在树下坐一会儿，看看动静。
lines.en: I'll sit under the tree and watch a while.

lines.zh: 夜里出来，才没人赶我。
lines.en: Coming out at night, nobody shoos me.

lines.zh: 黑下来的时候，我的眼睛会发白。
lines.en: In the dark my eyes turn white.

lines.zh: 这段水流把我推到箱子边。
lines.en: This current pushed me to a chest.

lines.zh: 这地方，箱子不少。
lines.en: Plenty of chests around here.

lines.zh: 夜一黑，我的眼睛就亮。
lines.en: Night falls and my eyes light up.

lines.zh: 河岸上，有箱子的味道。
lines.en: On the bank, the smell of a chest.

lines.zh: 先闻闻，再翻翻。
lines.en: Sniff first, then rummage.

lines.zh: 远处有熔炉的烟。
lines.en: Smoke from a furnace far off.

lines.zh: 别看我小，翻箱子不输。
lines.en: Small, but I match anyone at chests.

lines.zh: 平原的夜里，我的眼睛在发光。
lines.en: On the plains at night, my eyes glow.

lines.zh: 暗处我的眼睛像灯泡。
lines.en: In the dark my eyes glow like bulbs.

lines.zh: 毛一沾火就焦，离我远点。
lines.en: My fur singes fast — stay back.

lines.zh: 烫！我的毛尖卷了！
lines.en: Hot! My fur tips are curling!

lines.zh: 从树上掉下来，屁股先着地。
lines.en: Off the tree, and I land on my rear.

lines.zh: 从树杈上滑下来，屁股先着地。
lines.en: Slid off the branch — landed on my rear.

lines.zh: 水太深，我只会扑腾。
lines.en: Too deep; I can only thrash.

lines.zh: 头被按下去，毛全沉。
lines.en: Head held under. My fur drags me down.

lines.zh: 响声把我从桶边震飞。
lines.en: The blast threw me from the barrel.

lines.zh: 连海龟蛋我都能吃，怕炮？
lines.en: I can eat even turtle eggs — what's a blast?

lines.zh: 箭擦过耳朵，差一点。
lines.en: The arrow grazed my ear — too close.

lines.zh: 箭！谁守着我翻过的箱子？
lines.en: An arrow! Who guards the chest I opened?

lines.zh: 咒语让我眼睛里的光灭了。
lines.en: The spell put out the light in my eyes.

lines.zh: 紫光一闪，眼睛刺痛。
lines.en: Purple light flashes. My eyes sting.

lines.zh: 空桶翻了三遍，什么也没有。
lines.en: I've turned three empty barrels over.

lines.zh: 连海龟蛋都啃不动了。
lines.en: I can't even crack a turtle egg.

lines.zh: 雷声吓得我钻进箱子。
lines.en: The thunder sent me into a chest.

lines.zh: 雷声大，我的眼睛更亮。
lines.en: Loud thunder only makes my eyes brighter.

lines.zh: 我爪子抓空了，下面没东西。
lines.en: My paws caught nothing — nothing below.

lines.zh: 白眼睛在暗处发亮。
lines.en: White eyes glow in the dark.
